city.Fiji.description: This nation of more than 330 islands in the South Pacific is famous for its warm turquoise sea, gardens of soft coral loved by divers, and the ceremonial sharing of a peppery drink called kava.
city.Fiji.landmark: aerial view of a tiny palm-covered island ringed by a turquoise coral lagoon
city.Fiji.greeting: In Fijian, hello is “Bula” (BOO-lah) — it also means life and good health!
city.Fiji.flag: studied a flag in a guidebook: light blue, with a little Union Jack and a shield

city.Fiji.clue.1: kept talking about a place where people walk barefoot across hot glowing stones
city.Fiji.clue.2: swapped travelers' cheques for a roll of Fijian dollars
city.Kiribati.description: This country of low coral islands lies in the central Pacific, right where each new day on Earth begins — making it one of the first places to see the sunrise.
city.Kiribati.landmark: thin low coral atoll with palms and an outrigger canoe on a calm turquoise lagoon at sunrise
city.Kiribati.greeting: In the local language, Gilbertese, hello is “Mauri” (MAH-oo-ree).
city.Kiribati.flag: doodled a flag with a golden bird flying over a rising sun, above three white ocean waves
city.Kiribati.clue.0: couldn't wait to catch a sunrise where each brand-new day on Earth first begins
city.Kiribati.clue.1: described tiny, flat islands so low that the sea is never more than a short walk away
city.Kiribati.clue.2: packed a snorkel to swim over bright coral reefs full of fish
city.Marshall Islands.description: This country is a scattered chain of low coral atolls in the central Pacific, barely rising above the waves. Long ago its sailors found their way using clever wooden "stick charts" that read the ocean's swells.
city.Marshall Islands.landmark: aerial view of a ring-shaped coral atoll enclosing a deep blue lagoon
city.Marshall Islands.greeting: In Marshallese, hello is “Iọkwe” (YAWK-way) — it also wishes you love.
city.Marshall Islands.flag: dark blue, with orange-over-white stripes sweeping up to a white star
city.Marshall Islands.clue.0: wanted to dive down to sunken warships resting quietly on a lagoon floor
city.Marshall Islands.clue.1: loved that this place made a giant safe zone where sharks are protected
city.Micronesia.description: This country is spread across hundreds of islands in the western Pacific. It is famous for Nan Madol, an ancient stone city built on tiny man-made islands, and for the giant stone-disc money still prized on Yap.
city.Micronesia.landmark: mysterious stacked-basalt ruins of Nan Madol rising from the water on little islets
city.Micronesia.flag: drew a flag: plain light blue with four little white stars in a diamond
city.Micronesia.clue.0: packed for island-hopping across a scattered country in the western Pacific
city.Micronesia.clue.1: was amazed by an ancient stone city built on hundreds of little man-made islands
